findings.reason: The loop writes one independent temporary fixture program per report contract, before executing those children to prove malformed/empty/stale/failed reports are rejected. Actual per-file writes are necessary to test the runner subprocess and filesystem boundary. This bounded tooling setup is not a product N+1; caching or skipping files would weaken the self-check.
